hints.tr: 50 saat ileri ya da 5 saat geri gidince başlangıç kodu 0–23 dışına çıkıyor.
hints.en: Going 50 hours forward or 5 hours back, the starter code leaves 0–23.

hints.tr: `(hour + hours) % 24` her durumda 0 ile 23 arası verir.
hints.en: `(hour + hours) % 24` gives 0 to 23 in every case.

hints.tr:
Çözümün tamamı:

```python
def clock_after(hour, hours):
    return (hour + hours) % 24

print(clock_after(22, 5))
print(clock_after(10, 50))
print(clock_after(3, -5))
```
hints.en:
The full solution:

```python
def clock_after(hour, hours):
    return (hour + hours) % 24

print(clock_after(22, 5))
print(clock_after(10, 50))
print(clock_after(3, -5))
```
